Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 1, Verse 8

“Yourself, Bhishma, Karna, the ever-victorious Kripa, Ashvatthama, Vikarna, and the son of Somadatta.”

Duryodhana names his own generals — starting with Drona himself and the towering figure of Bhishma, the two elder statesmen whose loyalty, despite personal reservations about the war, remains with the Kaurava side.
